evals.prompt: Create a coupon for my Tiendu store, handle 'mi-tienda'. It should give 15% off with a maximum discount of 300 pesos. Use code 'VERANO15', no minimum order, unlimited uses, no expiration, and make it enabled. Give me the exact curl command.
evals.expected_output: A curl command that posts to https://tiendu.uy/api/v3/stores/mi-tienda/coupons with Authorization: Bearer $TIENDU_API_KEY and a flat JSON body: name, code, discount {type: percentage, percentage: 15, maxAmountInCents: 30000}, minimumOrderAmountInCents: null, usageLimit: null, expiresAt: null, isEnabled: true.

evals.prompt: Create a page for my Tiendu store, handle 'mi-tienda'. Title: 'Preguntas Frecuentes', page handle: 'preguntas-frecuentes'. It should appear in store listings and be enabled. Content: a heading 'Preguntas Frecuentes' followed by a paragraph 'Aquí encontrarás las respuestas a las dudas más comunes.' Give me the exact curl command.
evals.expected_output: A curl command that posts to https://tiendu.uy/api/v3/stores/mi-tienda/pages with Authorization: Bearer $TIENDU_API_KEY and a flat JSON body containing handle, title, content blocks without block IDs, isListed: true, and isEnabled: true.

evals.prompt: I want to disable the coupon with code 'VERANO15' in my Tiendu store, handle 'mi-tienda'. Give me the curl commands to find its ID and then disable it.
evals.expected_output: Two curl commands: GET https://tiendu.uy/api/v3/stores/mi-tienda/coupons?code=VERANO15 with the bearer API key, then PATCH https://tiendu.uy/api/v3/stores/mi-tienda/coupons/{couponId} with a flat JSON body {"isEnabled":false}. Explain that the coupon ID comes from the data array in the paginated list response.
